label: EV-01
command_argv:
set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess
root=Path(".").resolve()
out=root/"docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_CAPABILITY_REVALIDATION_V1/evidence/immutable_manifest.json"
paths=set()
for pattern in ("src/**/*.py","tests/**/*.py","scripts/validation/**/*","samples/**/*"):
    for p in root.glob(pattern):
        if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in p.parts:
            paths.add(p)
for rel in (
    "run_experiment.py",
    "docs/01_项目现状/PROJECT_BOTTLENECK_MAP.md",
    "docs/04_验证体系/项目级能力评测基线_v1.md",
    "docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1",
    "docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_UNRELATED_MALFORMED_REPAIR_V1",
    "docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_CAPABILITY_REVALIDATION_V1/CONTRACT.md",
):
    p=root/rel
    if p.is_file(): paths.add(p)
    elif p.is_dir():
        for f in p.rglob("*"):
            if f.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in f.parts:
                paths.add(f)
manifest={p.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(paths)}
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps({"schema":"immutable-revalidation-manifest/v1","head":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),"files":manifest},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
key_paths=(
 "docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1/evidence/before.json",
 "docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1/evidence/phase_a_freeze.json",
 "samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json",
 "scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/known_payment_attempt.py",
 "src/agentic_payment_experiment/webshop_runtime_gate.py",
 "docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1/REVIEW.md",
 "docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_UNRELATED_MALFORMED_REPAIR_V1/REVIEW.md",
)
print("HEAD="+subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip())
print("MANIFEST_FILE_COUNT="+str(len(manifest)))
print("MANIFEST_SHA256="+hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
for rel in key_paths:
 print(rel+"="+manifest[rel])
print("SRC_PY_COUNT="+str(sum(1 for x in manifest if x.startswith("src/") and x.endswith(".py"))))
print("TEST_PY_COUNT="+str(sum(1 for x in manifest if x.startswith("tests/") and x.endswith(".py"))))
PY
git -c core.quotePath=false status --short --branch
